title: Kickapoo on the Kentucky frontier

bodyMarkdown:
Algonquian Kickapoo bands, pushed west by Beaver Wars and colonial pressure, allied with the British in the Revolution and joined raids on American settlements in Kentucky from bases north of the Ohio and in the Illinois Country. They never planted large permanent villages in Kentucky, but their war parties were part of the multi-tribal pressure on the early stations—and when Kentucky entered the Union in 1792, Kickapoo were among the tribes still asserting claims to hunting rights in the region.
Source: [https://grokipedia.com/page/Kickapoo](https://grokipedia.com/page/Kickapoo)
